verdict.rationale: The front-door probe found robots.txt returning HTTP 200 and the guidance pages open to every agent; only the /e-services/ transaction paths (the account surface, not the public reading surface) are disallowed. Readable text was extracted from multiple guidance pages (tax.ny.gov, /online/, /bus/ct/article9a.htm, /bus/doingbus/hire.htm), which indicates server-rendered content reachable without a key. missing for 10: an explicit probe record of the user agent used and of the absence of a CAPTCHA or bot-challenge interstitial, explicit confirmation that pages are not JS-only shells, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: the guidance pages are open to every agent, but the /e-services/ transaction paths (Online Services account surface) are robots-disallowed for all user agents
